## About
Old Style Body Shop sits on Dorsett Rd in Maryland Heights and works on collision repair, restoration and customization of all types of vehicles, foreign and domestic.
Our mission is simple: quality craftsmanship at an affordable price. We tell you what the damage really is and what could add to the cost, and we fix it right.
Neighbors have given us a 4.4 rating from 71 Google reviews. Come by and meet the crew.

## Services
- Collision repair: Getting your car back to right after an accident, big or small.
- Frame straightening: Bringing a bent frame back into shape after a hit.
- Car painting: Paint work to match and finish your repair.
- Glass installation: Replacing broken or damaged auto glass.
- Truck body repair & painting: Dents, panels and paint on pickups and work trucks.
- Corvette repair: We are Corvette repair specialists.
- RV repair: Body repair for your RV.
- Restoration and customization: Restoring and customizing all types of vehicles.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment for an estimate?
A: No. Estimates do not require an appointment, so just come by.

Q: When can I come in for an estimate?
A: Come by anytime between 9:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. Monday through Friday.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We work on foreign and domestic vehicles.
